Method of Attack: Logic error during CAPWAP packet processing enabling arbitrary code execution with administrative privileges or causing a DoS condition.
Impacted Systems: Cisco IOS XE Software for Catalyst 9000 Family Wireless Controllers
Attack Vector: Sending a crafted CAPWAP packet to an affected device.

Method of Attack: Insufficient bounds check allowing specially-crafted traffic to execute arbitrary code with root-level privileges or cause a device reload.
Impacted Systems: Cloud Services Router 1000V Series with SD-WAN feature enabled
Attack Vector: Transmitting specially-crafted network traffic to the device.

Method of Attack: Uninitialized variable in AAA function allowing an authenticated remote adversary to manipulate or delete network device configurations or corrupt memory, resulting in a DoS.
Attack Vector: Exploitation of an uninitialized variable in the AAA function.
